parent_binding.noncircularity: This contract binds already-frozen raw inputs and contains neither its own hash nor a future implementation hash; the controller must bind delivered source separately after exit.

job_contract: controller-created canonical bytes bind only stage, experiment, spec bundle, immutable source/image provenance, mode, and exact half-open [start_n,end_exclusive_n); no endpoint state, expected arithmetic, expected point, expected statistic, or decision is supplied

combined_formula_contract.forbidden: literal pole summation or any p1/p2/p3/p4 implementation

modes.tiny_point: For controller-selected tiny ranges, emit the exact parent/S0 canonical point sequence only. Reconstruct bbpPartial (7*start_n) inclusively from k=0 through 7*start_n from scratch, then advance each transition with j=1 through 7; never consume a prior shard or supplied checkpoint.
modes.future_window_256: For a later separately authorized 256-transition job, emit exactly the complete canonical parent/S0 window artifact: ten counts, J, all 255 positive-lag C/A/Z records, exact raw maximum ratio and lexicographically first tie witness, and decision fields. C0=256 is derived and enforced internally and is never emitted. The controller enforces mandatory identities over emitted fields; do not emit extra identity fields. Field types, keys, ordering, canonical raw bytes, formulas, and decision precedence are exactly those frozen by the parent CONTRACT/INTERFACE/TEST_PLAN and accepted S0 schema; this stage may not redefine them. window13_action is operational only when window_index is exactly 13. This mode is specified but inactive and cannot run a production index.

controller_test_hook: A controller-only isolated hook may pass synthetic canonical point records directly into S1's statistic function. It is not exposed by the production CLI, is unreachable from production jobs, cannot select arithmetic inputs, and returns the exact parent/S0 artifact solely for hidden statistics tests.
arithmetic_contract: derive Q_N,F_N,H_N,d_N,e_N,X_N,k_N,W_N,R_N through the canonical T118 combined-term/gcd normalization route
emit only exact n,r,w,cell with W_N>0, 0<=R_N<W_N, and cell=Int.ediv (10*R_N) W_N
P_N is inclusive through term m=7*N and F_N uses the next seven terms j=1..7; no unscaled-Q, modulo-10, float, or decimal approximation
source_separation: Dedicated generator source tree and networkless read-only image; only frozen specs, job bytes, and bounded scratch are mounted. No shared arithmetic module with S2 or the third route.

requirements: shard 2 succeeds with no predecessor artifact or checkpoint
controller independently compares every emitted point against the third route
reject supplied endpoint or expected arithmetic fields, gap, overlap, duplicate, reorder, range swap, source/spec substitution

third_route_requirement: A later controller-owned oracle, with independently frozen source and no import/copy from S1, must reconstruct every tiny record before S1 can be accepted.
activation_preconditions: all tiny mutations and third-route comparisons pass
hidden synthetic 256-point artifacts exercise counts/J/all C/A/Z/max/tie/decision through production statistic code before future_window_256 is eligible
nonclaims: No production window, CAS object, receipt, occupancy result, density, cancellation, V1, or Pi result is produced or claimed.
